name: CheckHarbor
subtitle: Track builds until recovery
description:
Keep failed builds visible until their matching recovery arrives. CheckHarbor is an independent recovery inbox for GitHub Actions on explicitly selected repositories.

• Group repeated failures into durable episodes
• Match recovery by repository, branch, and workflow
• Acknowledge and snooze while keeping failures unresolved
• Review first failure, latest failure, and recovery links
• See stale data, authentication errors, and rate limit backoff
• Open unresolved episodes with a configurable global shortcut
• Explore fictional workflows in Sample mode without credentials

Add public repositories by owner and name. Private repositories require an optional fine grained token with Actions read access stored in Keychain. Choose a polling interval and recovered history retention in Settings. Unresolved episodes stay until recovery or local deletion. Delete local history and repositories in Settings and remove the Keychain token separately. The default shortcut is Command Shift H and can be changed or disabled.

Recent API history is bounded and polling gaps can miss runs. Monitoring works while the app is open. No source code or logs are fetched. Repository metadata and episodes remain local. No analytics or developer backend. All features are included with one purchase.

Privacy policy and support are available in the app and on its linked website.
